everyone we aim to do this by building the operating system for global trade a strategic model combining advanced technology and data analytics logistics infrastructure and supply chain expertise flexport today connects almost 10 000 clients and suppliers across 109 countries including established global brands like georgia pacific as well as emerging innovators like sonos started in 2013 we
